sections.label: Cohesive society, sustainable population
sections.summary: Singapore aims to stay cohesive and resilient with a sustainable population, be good for families, jobs and living, and include all committed to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Our goal is to ensure that Singapore remains a cohesive and resilient society with a sustainable population.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We aim to make Singapore a great place for starting families and raising children and where Singaporeans can have good jobs and enjoy a quality living environment.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Singapore is a multicultural society where everyone who shares our ideals and is committed to Singapore has a place, regardless of race, language or religion.

sections.label: Citizen marriages and births
sections.summary: In the last two years, citizen marriages and births were among their highest levels in more than a decade.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: In the last two years, citizen marriages and births were among their highest levels in more than a decade.

sections.label: Ageing population and foreign workforce
sections.summary: Singapore's seniors are projected to double to 900,000 by 2030, needing calibrated new citizens and foreigners while slowing foreign workforce growth.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Singapore has one of the most rapidly ageing populations in the world, with the number of seniors projected to double to 900,000 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: While we encourage marriage and parenthood, we will need a carefully calibrated number of new citizens to keep our citizen population stable.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will also need foreigners to complement our Singaporean workforce in areas where we are short.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will strike a careful balance, so that Singaporeans do not feel crowded out and we can meet the needs of our ageing citizen population and workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We have slowed the growth of our foreign workforce substantially and, as a result, our total population growth rate last year was the slowest in more than a decade.
